scientific_integrity: Direct finite-field proof and reproducible exhaustive checks. Novel component consists of prescribed nonzero fibers, exact image, and commutator width; no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The formula is confined to class-two graphical groups of the friendship graphs; the zero commutator fiber is implied by established conjugacy-class counts and is not claimed as a new result. Full literature priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: Exact commutator fibers and commutator width for friendship graphical groups
